about: Hand-written synthetic relation set (P1-D, 2026-10-22). Each case: memories already stored (`existing`, with optional event dates) and one new `candidate`. `expected.op` uses the v2 vocabulary: ADD (unrelated or coexisting), DUPLICATE (same fact), UPDATE (supersedes target: newer, same subject and slot, stated by the user/document), EXTEND (adds detail, target stays true), CONFLICT (contradicts target but must not silently supersede: hearsay vs the user's own words, or genuinely uncertain), HISTORICAL (contradicts target but is OLDER in event time: keep as history, never supersede). The current engine can only answer new/duplicate/updates/extends; any 'updates' on a non-UPDATE case is a false UPDATE, the metric that matters most. Not yet spot-checked by the owner.
